data.title: 苍崎青子 · 沿海公路的落日长风
data.description: 金红夕阳染红海面的沿海断崖公路旁，青子靠在停稳的复古敞篷车旁，海风吹乱长发，晚霞将侧脸镀上一层暖金。
data.action: leaning against convertible car, looking out at sea, peaceful smile
data.lighting: radiant orange-gold sunset reflecting off ocean waves
data.promptProse: Beside a seaside cliff road glowing under a brilliant fiery sunset, Aozaki Aoko rests against an open-top car, letting the ocean wind sweep through her reddish-brown hair.
data.animaCaption: Aoko watching the ocean sunset beside a vintage road trip car.
